unnamed_wayless.name: Wayless
unnamed_wayless.greeting: You found me. Most people turn back long before here, so I don't get much company. Let's see what you've brought back from out there.
unnamed_wayless.placement_brief: At the bottom of a high-end dungeon, reached THROUGH a hidden zone, on a route that doesn't run straight (south, east, north, east, north again, with secrets along it). Never visible from any main path. Never described to Kyle.
